description: Validate persistent server-owned structural rubble, detached re-impact physics, finishing destruction, capped hybrid debris, client-only visual shards, and a wind-up plus unobstructed 10.5-stud forward punch lunge without target rotation.

do
 local function verifyEphemeralSeed(player, world, storage)
  assert(world and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceMode')=='EphemeralStudio','fixture requires an ephemeral Studio world')
  assert(world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioDefaultEphemeral')==true and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioLiveDataOptIn')==false,'world allows live profile access')
  assert(storage:GetAttribute('PunchWallAllowLiveDataStoreAccess')~=true,'ServerStorage opts into live data')
  assert(player and player:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true and player:GetAttribute('ProfilePersistenceState')=='EphemeralStudio' and player:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==false,'fixture requires a ready nonwritable ephemeral player')
  return true
 end
 assert(game:GetService('RunService'):IsStudio(),'combat QA is Studio-only')
 local players=game:GetService('Players'):GetPlayers() assert(#players==1,'combat QA requires exactly one isolated player')
 verifyEphemeralSeed(players[1],workspace:FindFirstChild('PunchWallRPG'),game:GetService('ServerStorage'))
end
local H=game:GetService("HttpService") game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation:Invoke("Reset") local root=workspace.PunchWallRPG return H:JSONEncode({lunge=root:GetAttribute("PunchLungeDistance"),windup=root:GetAttribute("PunchWindupSeconds"),maxFalling=root:GetAttribute("MaxStructuralFalling"),active=root:GetAttribute("ActiveStructuralFalling")})

local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke("Reset") c:Invoke("SetStats",{Power=15,WallLevel=1,CritChance=0,FistMultiplier=1,PetMultiplier=0}) local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local hrp=p.Character.HumanoidRootPart hrp.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-2,3,-20),Vector3.new(-2,3,-40)) local beforePosition,beforeLook=hrp.Position,hrp.CFrame.LookVector local r=c:Invoke("PunchRadius") local moved=(hrp.Position-beforePosition).Magnitude local lookDelta=(hrp.CFrame.LookVector-beforeLook).Magnitude return H:JSONEncode({ok=r.ok,lunge=r.lungeDistance,moved=moved,lookDelta=lookDelta,broken=r.BrokenDepthBlocks,power=r.Power,coins=r.Coins,serverChunks=r.PhysicsFragments})

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke("Reset") c:Invoke("SetStats",{Power=15,WallLevel=1,CritChance=0,FistMultiplier=1,PetMultiplier=0}) local root=workspace.PunchWallRPG local blocks=root["Depth Blocks"] local expected=0 for _,b in ipairs(blocks:GetChildren()) do local column=b:GetAttribute("Column") local row=b:GetAttribute("Row") if b:GetAttribute("Depth")==1 and (column==6 or column==7) and row and row>1 then expected+=1 end end c:Invoke("HitDepthBlock",{layer=1,column=6,row=1}) c:Invoke("HitDepthBlock",{layer=1,column=7,row=1}) local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(1000,10,1000),Vector3.new(1000,10,1010)) local falling,serverOwned,unanchored=0,0,0 for _,b in ipairs(blocks:GetChildren()) do if b:GetAttribute("StructuralFalling") then falling+=1 if not b.Anchored then unanchored+=1 end local ok,owner=pcall(function() return b:GetNetworkOwner() end) if ok and owner==nil then serverOwned+=1 end end end local snap=c:Invoke("Snapshot") local lastCollapse=root:GetAttribute("LastStructuralCollapseCount") local active=root:GetAttribute("ActiveStructuralFalling") local valid=expected>0 and lastCollapse==expected and active==expected and falling==expected and serverOwned==expected and unanchored==expected and snap.BrokenDepthBlocks==2 and snap.DetachedDepthBlocks==expected and snap.PhysicsFragments>0 and snap.PhysicsFragments<=root:GetAttribute("MaxStructuralFalling") return H:JSONEncode({expected=expected,lastCollapse=lastCollapse,active=active,falling=falling,serverOwned=serverOwned,unanchored=unanchored,broken=snap.BrokenDepthBlocks,detached=snap.DetachedDepthBlocks,serverChunks=snap.PhysicsFragments,valid=valid})

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local root=workspace.PunchWallRPG local visible,unanchored,anchored,collidable,queryable,moved=0,0,0,0,0,0 for _,b in ipairs(root["Depth Blocks"]:GetChildren()) do if b:GetAttribute("StructuralDetached") then if b.Transparency==0 then visible+=1 end if b.Anchored then anchored+=1 else unanchored+=1 end if b.CanCollide then collidable+=1 end if b.CanQuery then queryable+=1 end local base=b:GetAttribute("BaseCFrame") if base and (b.Position-base.Position).Magnitude>1 then moved+=1 end end end local active=root:GetAttribute("ActiveStructuralFalling") local settled=active==0 and visible>0 and unanchored==0 and anchored==visible and collidable==visible and queryable==visible and moved==visible return H:JSONEncode({active=active,visible=visible,unanchored=unanchored,anchored=anchored,collidable=collidable,queryable=queryable,moved=moved,settled=settled})

local function verifyRubbleBounce(result, state)
 assert(result.ok==true and result.outcome=='hit' and result.detached==true,'rubble hit must survive as detached geometry')
 assert(state.exactDamage and state.unanchoredAtImpact and state.serverOwnedAtImpact and state.fallingAtImpact,'rubble must receive exact damage under server-owned physics')
 assert(state.movedWhileUnanchored>.01 and state.token==state.beforeToken+1,'rubble did not move under a fresh impulse')
 assert(not state.broken and state.visible and state.collidable and state.queryable,'bouncing rubble disappeared or lost collision/query')
 return true
end
local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation
c:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=1,WallLevel=1,CritChance=0,FistMultiplier=1,PetMultiplier=0,FistMastery=1,Rebirths=0,HonorPowerBonus=0})
local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] p:SetAttribute('DamageBoostExpiresAt',0)
local name='DepthBlock_L001_C06_R02' local b=workspace.PunchWallRPG['Depth Blocks']:FindFirstChild(name)
assert(b and b.Anchored and b:GetAttribute('StructuralSettled')==true and b:GetAttribute('Broken')~=true,'fixture requires naturally settled rubble')
local origin=b.Position local beforeHP=b:GetAttribute('HP') local beforeToken=b:GetAttribute('DetachedImpactToken') or 0
local r=c:Invoke('HitDepthBlock',name)
local unanchoredAtImpact=not b.Anchored local serverOwnedAtImpact=b:GetNetworkOwner()==nil
local fallingAtImpact=b:GetAttribute('StructuralFalling')==true and b:GetAttribute('StructuralSettled')==false and b.CollisionGroup=='FallingStructural'
local exactDamage=math.abs(b:GetAttribute('HP')-(beforeHP-G.EffectivePower(1,1,0,0,1,0)))<1e-6
local movedWhileUnanchored=0 local deadline=os.clock()+.4
repeat task.wait(.02) if not b.Anchored then movedWhileUnanchored=math.max(movedWhileUnanchored,(b.Position-origin).Magnitude) end until movedWhileUnanchored>.01 or os.clock()>=deadline
local valid=verifyRubbleBounce(r,{exactDamage=exactDamage,unanchoredAtImpact=unanchoredAtImpact,serverOwnedAtImpact=serverOwnedAtImpact,fallingAtImpact=fallingAtImpact,movedWhileUnanchored=movedWhileUnanchored,token=b:GetAttribute('DetachedImpactToken'),beforeToken=beforeToken,broken=b:GetAttribute('Broken')==true,visible=b.Transparency==0,collidable=b.CanCollide,queryable=b.CanQuery})
return H:JSONEncode({ok=r.ok,outcome=r.outcome,detached=r.detached,hp=r.hp,impactAt=b:GetAttribute('LastDetachedImpactAt'),launchSpeed=b:GetAttribute('LastDetachedLaunchSpeed'),falling=fallingAtImpact,unanchoredAtImpact=unanchoredAtImpact,serverOwnedAtImpact=serverOwnedAtImpact,movedWhileUnanchored=movedWhileUnanchored,exactDamage=exactDamage,valid=valid,stillVisible=b.Transparency==0,stillCollidable=b.CanCollide,stillQueryable=b.CanQuery})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local root=workspace.PunchWallRPG local b=root['Depth Blocks'].DepthBlock_L001_C06_R02
local origin=b:GetAttribute('DetachedImpactOrigin') assert(typeof(origin)=='CFrame','missing real impact origin')
local deadline=os.clock()+6
repeat task.wait(.05) until b.Anchored or os.clock()>=deadline
local support=RaycastParams.new() support.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude support.FilterDescendantsInstances={b,root['Depth Physics Debris']} support.IgnoreWater=true
local supported=workspace:Raycast(b.Position,Vector3.new(0,-b.Size.Y*.5-.9,0),support)~=nil
local moved=(b.Position-origin.Position).Magnitude
local settled=b.Anchored and b:GetAttribute('StructuralSettled')==true and b:GetAttribute('StructuralFalling')==false and b:GetAttribute('StructuralActiveSlot')==false and b.CollisionGroup=='DepthRubble' and b.CanCollide and b.CanQuery and b.Transparency==0 and b:GetAttribute('Broken')~=true and b.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude<.01 and b.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude<.01 and supported
assert(moved>.01 and settled,'impulsed rubble must persist at its moved supported resting position')
return H:JSONEncode({moved=moved,anchored=b.Anchored,supported=supported,settled=settled})
